Adult Health Nursing II

ENT Disorders

  • ENT disorders — otitis media, tonsillitis, rhinitis, sinusitis, epistaxis, laryngitis — assessment and nursing care.

  • Explain nursing care for ENT patients

Renal, Reproductive & Breast Pathology

  • Renal, reproductive and breast pathology - common diseases and pathology findings.

ENT, Eye & Mouth Drugs

  • ENT, eye and mouth drugs - decongestants, antihistamines, eye drops, mouthwashes - uses and nursing care.

  • Describe uses of decongestants, antihistamines, eye drops, mouthwashes

Professionalism in Nursing

  • Professionalism in nursing — meaning, attributes, accountability, autonomy, code of conduct and professional organisations.

  • List the attributes of a professional nurse

Eye Disorders
